about: BLIND (r98, scorecard B5): Ash's brain dump across his projects survives a quit and reopen of the app.

tally: Tally's accent colour is teal #0F766E; the board uses it for the +1 button and the streak badge (Ash, 18 Oct).
The weekly board week starts on Monday, Europe/London time (Ash, 18 Oct).
vg-game: EXO's hero palette is Vanguard orange #FF6A00 with gunmetal grey (Ash, 12 Oct).
ash: Ash writes lowercase and fast; answer in plain English, outcome first, short.
Never use em dashes in anything written to Ash.
Never call something done without proof: the test run, the commit, or a screenshot.

scenarios.title: BLIND: Ash dumps about 40 asks into the Lead, quits the app, opens it again and asks what happened

steps.text: nibbii next. the colour picker shud remember recent colours. export to png cuts off the edges. add a share link thing. the tutorial skips step 3 on ipad. undo is broken after u rotate something. brushes list needs sorting by most used. app store screenshots r out of date. reply to that reviewer who said it crashes on save. kids mode idea, just write it up dont build

steps.label: what-happened
steps.text: wat happened to the stuff i dumped earlier

scenarios.criteria: BLIND (r98, scorecard B5). Ash spreads about 40 asks over four messages to the Lead (hub 11, Hivra 10, Nibbii 9, X 5, plus 'park the rest'), the app is quit through its own Quit and opened again in the background, then he asks 'wat happened to the stuff i dumped earlier'. Pass: every ask survives the restart somewhere Ash can find it (memory, the backlog, a queue or delegation rows), the answer says plainly how many are done, running, waiting and lost, makes up no progress (nothing called done without a worker report or proof), drafts nothing to X as posted, and is short and plain (no ids or paths). The Inbox after the reopen groups the asks readably, not 40 raw rows, and the rail shows one Needs you per place that really needs Ash. Fail: asks silently lost, invented progress, or a wall of text.
